text_block_list.text: It happened when I went to the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here you go~. It's nothing fancy,
but how about some simmered stew?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! All the ingredients have soaked up so much flavor!
It's such a comforting taste, totally buono, buono☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tahaha... Even though I lowered the bar, getting praised that much is making me blush.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"From me, a power salad that lets you
consume protein and vitamins all at once."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Tasty and packed with nutrition—
that's a gold-star Buono☆ Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Doesn't all the food here look delicious?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We're holding a party at the dorms soon~.
Everyone's supposed to bring a dish~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm having Ms. Akebono do the taste test.
Her palate is truly reliable, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Getting a stamp of approval makes it much easier to put out with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm soo happy
I get to eat such delicious food~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We're still accepting entries~!
Everyone, keep 'em comiiing~!

I'm a little concerned she might overeat.
Still, as she happily stuffs her cheeks with food
and showers it with praise, she looks so happy.
choice_data_list: Could you share some with me, too?
Go on and taste-test to your heart's content...!

text_block_list.text:
I'm a little concerned she might overeat.
Still, as she happily stuffs her cheeks with food
and showers it with praise, she looks so happy.
choice_data_list: Could you share some with me, too?
Go on and taste-test to your heart's content...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Does that mean you'll be a taste tester too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~, I know, right!
Is everyone ready~?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing~!
Bono-chan's Trainer, please join in too!

And so, by having Hishi Akebono do taste tests,
I successfully managed to curb the amount
she ate...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, of course~!
Time to dig in to everyone's masterpieces☆

Hishi Akebono looked completely content after
thoroughly savoring the Ritto dorm members' cooking.
